worlds.title: 引力花园 / Gravity Garden
worlds.prompt: Compose an original 32-second instrumental miniature for a warm hand-painted gravity garden. Two distinct musical personalities: a sleepy round stone gardener represented by soft, woody bass plucks, and an impatient ribbon wind sprite represented by airy piccolo phrases. Playful acoustic chamber folk, tactile paper-and-gouache atmosphere, light brushed percussion, natural stereo space, around 96 BPM. Build a small humorous duet with four roughly 8-second chapters: 0-8 the stone slowly wakes and taps a steady low pattern while a tiny curious piccolo seed appears; 8-16 the wind gets overexcited, rapid rising piccolo notes scatter star-seeds into the air, with a brief gentle stumble; 16-24 the bass replies and the two find a call-and-response rhythm, low notes suggesting seeds returning to earth; 24-32 the motifs agree in a warm growing melody, resolving into a smiling, soft final chord with a short clean decay. Music should make light and heavy feel like opposing but friendly forces. Begin immediately without silence. No vocals, speech, choir, lyrics, aggressive synths or cinematic bombast. Create a new melody; do not imitate or quote Chippytea's song or any existing tune.

chapters.musicIntent: Slow woody bass taps and a curious piccolo pickup
Rising piccolo runs with a playful brief stumble
Shared motif blooms and lands softly

worlds.title: 月亮修补铺 / Moon Mending Shop
worlds.prompt: Compose an original 32-second instrumental miniature for a crooked, cozy hand-painted moon mending shop. A meticulous tailor chases a mischievous golden moon that keeps hiccupping and tugging its sewing thread. Use pizzicato chamber strings as the central voice, delicate sewing-like percussion made from tiny wooden clicks and muted brushed taps, occasional warm bowed string answers, around 112 BPM with a light skipping chase rhythm. Four roughly 8-second chapters: 0-8 a careful three-note stitch motif reveals a leaking patch of starlight; 8-16 the moon hiccups as an offbeat pluck and little rhythmic interruption, then a comic elastic chase develops; 16-24 the tailor catches the thread with three clearly articulated stitch accents and the two motifs weave together; 24-32 tension relaxes, the repaired moon floats happily, a soft lyrical phrase resolves with a clean short decay. Keep it handmade, witty, intimate and gently surprising, with dynamics that feel like pulling and releasing a thread. Begin immediately without silence. No vocals, speech, choir, lyrics, heavy drums or generic triumphant fanfare. Compose a new tune; do not imitate or quote Chippytea's song or any existing melody.

chapters.musicIntent: Offbeat interruption and a light elastic chase
Three stitch accents bring the motifs together
Tension releases into a floating warm resolution

worlds.title: 影子排练场 / Shadow Rehearsal
worlds.prompt: Compose an original 32-second instrumental miniature for a small folded-paper shadow theater. An extravagant charcoal shadow dancer and a shy amber light creature learn to share the stage. Two musical personalities: expressive bass clarinet with warm low-register leaps for the shadow, and delicate soft bells for the tiny light; a gentle hand drum provides physical pulse. Minimal acoustic theatrical jazz-folk, around 88 BPM, roomy but intimate, rich contrast between broad gestures and tiny hesitant replies. Four roughly 8-second chapters: 0-8 cautious bass clarinet steps and one quiet bell invitation; 8-16 increasingly large clarinet gestures and rounded hand-drum accents suggest the shadow growing too tall and almost hitting the roof, followed by a funny small pause; 16-24 the light answers with gentle bells, the clarinet softens and the motifs alternate large and small; 24-32 the pair find a balanced dancing shape, a simple shared phrase resolves warmly with a short clean decay. Use musical space and dynamics so changes in size and courage can be choreographed. Begin immediately without silence. No vocals, speech, choir, lyrics, harsh brass, electronic drops or epic orchestration. Create a new melody; do not imitate or quote Chippytea's song or any existing tune.

chapters.musicIntent: Cautious clarinet steps and a tiny bell invitation
Broad leaps, rounded hand-drum accents and a comic pause
Soft bells and smaller clarinet replies alternate
Balanced duet and a warm compact resolution
